description: Replace the HTML of a page you already published, keeping the SAME link. Use this for every revision — a fix, a new draft, refreshed numbers — instead of publishing a new page, so a link the user already shared keeps working. Only pages owned by the same API key's account can be updated.

html.description: The full, self-contained replacement HTML document.

slug.description: The page's slug (the part after /p/), or its full URL.

name: update_page
title: Update a published page in place
